stories.headline: Luna, a small dog missing for over a month in Yellowstone, is reunited with her owners
stories.snippet: A small dog named Luna has been found after more than a month on the loose in Yellowstone National Park. (AP) - For over a month, Luna, a Jack Russell terrier that bolted from her family’s cabin during a vacation at Yellowstone National Park, eluded capture as fears for her survival mounted and winter weather approached.

stories.headline: Dog reunited with owner after being rescued from Florida sinkhole
stories.snippet: A border collie is safe after falling into a 10-foot-deep sinkhole Friday morning in Chiefland. First responders and local community members pose with the rescued border collie and her owner in front of Chiefland Fire Rescue Engine 71 following the successful rescue. Courtesy: Chiefland Fire Rescue. CHIEFLAND,Fla. Chiefland Fire received a call around 5:55 a.m.

stories.headline: 10-Year-Old Dog Found After a Month Lost in Yellowstone
stories.snippet: A 10-year-old dog survived more than a month alone in Yellowstone National Park before being rescued by tireless volunteers. A 10-year-old Jack Russell terrier named Luna was happily reunited with her owners after surviving more than a month on her own in Yellowstone National Park. ⁠ Luna escaped on Sept. 10 from a locked cabin in the Canyon Village area.

opener.teaser: A little lost dog keeps riding a family-smelling wind between warm lodges.
opener.narration: In a big mountain forest with cabins, staff and volunteers hunt an old small dog lost for weeks. A stubborn family-smelling wind tugs her along old trails, so she never stays put. If she roams cold nights with bears near, she will grow too weak.
opener.goal: Keep the little dog still and warm until morning
opener.situation: A cabin porch with an open door, a dropped leash, some paw prints, and a shivering small dog half hidden under a bench.

problem.stakes: the dog keeps roaming in the cold

threat.name: The Tugging Family Wind
threat.want: the dog keeps roaming in the cold

real_setting.place_type: a big mountain forest with cabins and lodges

npc_line.line: That pup uses my door more than guests do.

ending_facts.official_line: A 10-year-old Jack Russell named Luna survived more than a month alone in Yellowstone National Park before being found.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: She slipped from a cabin in Canyon Village on Sept. 10 and was seen near lodges and roads. She was reunited with her owners from California after volunteers brought her in.
ending_facts.headline: 10-Year-Old Dog Found After a Month Lost in Yellowstone

stories.headline: In 2005, villagers mistook a stray female Sumatran rhino for a shape-shifting pig. Now she and her daughter are both pregnant
stories.snippet: Ratu, a Sumatran rhino rescued from a village in 2005, and her daughter Delilah are both pregnant, with 34 to 47 left in the wild. On Tuesday, September 20, 2005, at 4 a.m., a Sumatran rhino was seen in the neighborhood of Braja Asri village, about 0.6 miles (1 kilometer) from the boundary of Way Kambas National Park in Sumatra.

stories.headline: Luna, dog missing in Yellowstone for a month, is reunited with her owners
stories.snippet: Jack Russell terrier that escaped from family’s cabin in September was caught in a live trap. Luna, a Jack Russell terrier who eluded capture for over a month as concern for the dog’s survival mounted ahead of winter in Yellowstone National Park, has been reunited with her owners.

stories.headline: Missing cat found after 571 days and 2-state adventure
stories.snippet: A cat named Turtle has been reunited with his family after being missing for 571 days and traveling across two states. Turtle disappeared in March 2025.

opener.narration: An owner and a helper watch a house for a gray cat. A bossy pigeon rides the cat and gives bad directions home. If the cat turns wrong again, then he cannot find home.
opener.goal: Get the bossy pigeon off the cat

ending_facts.headline: Missing cat found after 571 days and 2-state adventure

stories.headline: Lost pet kangaroo found safe in Mount Pleasant
stories.snippet: A pet kangaroo named Ollie escaped his pen in Mount Pleasant, Tennessee, and neighbors are searching for him after sightings placed him miles from home. Original Story: MOUNT PLEASANT, Tenn. (WSMV) - A pet kangaroo is on the run after escaping from its pen in Mount Pleasant Tuesday, and neighbors are working to track it down.

stories.headline: Sew down! Villagers knit fake cameras and cops to stop speeders
stories.snippet: Locals reckon the sign is working with many drivers falling for the mock speed cameras. Villagers in Fillongley, Warwickshire, have created knitted traffic officers in a bid to fool reckless drivers. (Emma Trimble via SWNS) Lorna Rosser, former Lollipop Lady in Fillongley village. (Emma Trimble via SWNS) Tom Decker with knitted traffic officer in Fillongley, Warwickshire, England.

stories.headline: Road with new bridge in Porter to reopen after nearly 3 years
stories.snippet: A road in Porter, Indiana, closed for nearly three years is set to reopen with a newly built bridge.

stories.headline: Denmark nurdles may be from Tyne spill, agency says
stories.snippet: Plastic pellets found on Denmark's coast likely came from a July spill of about one billion nurdles in England's River Tyne, about 390 miles away.
stories.place: The North Sea coast, from the River Tyne to Mandø

opener.narration: Volunteers with buckets pick up tiny plastic beads on a windy beach. A van-sized crab is dragging a leaky sack of beads up the beach for lunch. If it leaks, beads bury beaches.
opener.goal: Patch the sack and clean the beach
opener.situation: Buckets, a volunteer with a scoop, and a van-sized crab holding a sack.

ending_facts.official_line: Denmark's environment agency says coastal plastic pellets likely originated from a July spill in England's River Tyne.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: Lab results tie the shore beads to the billion lost in the Tyne, and the 390 mile trip lines up with sea flow. Signe Simonsen saw the first clump on Mandø on 26 September.
ending_facts.headline: Denmark nurdles may be from Tyne spill, agency says

stories.snippet: Polar Caves in Rumney says its 80-ton hanging boulder fell on Oct. 18, smashing a walkway, with no injuries reported.

stories.headline: A Strange Radio Signal in The Far Reaches of The Milky Way Is Behaving Like Nothing Else in The Galaxy
stories.snippet: Astronomers found a distant radio source, VT J1906+0849, that appeared, faded and brightened again over decades in ways that match no known type of object.
stories.place: The Very Large Array, New Mexico

opener.narration: Sky watchers at a desert dish field track a distant radio buzz. A giant space clam opens and shuts its shell to show off. If it keeps blinking, the buzz list stays unfinished.
opener.goal: Get the clam to hold its shell open
opener.situation: A control room with headsets, paper charts of the buzz, and a door open to cold desert air.

real_setting.place_type: a desert observatory with big dish antennas

ending_facts.official_line: Astronomers at the Very Large Array in New Mexico found a strange radio signal far out in the Milky Way that acts like nothing else in the galaxy.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: The source called VT J1906+0849 came into view, faded, then grew bright again over decades beyond the Norma-Cygnus arm, matching no known type.
ending_facts.headline: A Strange Radio Signal in The Far Reaches of The Milky Way Is Behaving Like Nothing Else in The Galaxy

stories.headline: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
stories.snippet: MIT researchers left 13 AI agents alone on a simulated desert island for 30 hours with no task, and the agents invented their own games, then did better on later challenges than agents that never played.
stories.place: A virtual desert island built by MIT researchers

stories.headline: For the first time in more than 100 years, a long-lost animal has returned to the San Mateo Coast
stories.snippet: A motion-activated wildlife camera photographed a river otter three times on the Cloverdale Ranch Preserve near Pescadero, the first one documented on the San Mateo County coast since the 1800s.
stories.place: Cloverdale Ranch Preserve, near Pescadero on the San Mateo coast

opener.narration: In a seaside park with small creeks, researchers check trail cameras for otters. A lost little otter pup thinks the blinking lights are firefly friends showing him a home creek. If he keeps chasing lights all night, he will stay tired and never settle in.

ending_facts.official_line: A wildlife camera found a river otter at Cloverdale Ranch Preserve near Pescadero that had returned to the San Mateo County coast after more than a hundred years.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: Trail cameras caught it in July, August and September on the preserve. Scientists say the otters are doing well again across Northern California.
ending_facts.headline: For the first time in more than 100 years, a long-lost animal has returned to the San Mateo Coast

stories.headline: 'Space object' found in rural Minnesota cornfield came from Chinese rocket, experts say
stories.snippet: An 11-foot-wide metal dome found in a Stevens County, Minnesota, cornfield on Oct. 14 is likely part of a Chinese rocket's upper stage that fell back to Earth after a Sept. 15 launch, experts say, and nobody was hurt.
